# Heatmap

Heatmap: values over two sets of categories (such as weekdays and hours), colored on a sequential scale for
magnitude or a diverging scale around a midpoint. A color scale with the smallest and largest values (and the
midpoint) is always shown under the cells.

**Interaction**: each cell is its own hover target and gets an outline (its color is the value, so it does not
change); the tooltip shows the column, the row and the value. `Tab` focuses the chart (focus ring only for the
keyboard); the four arrow keys move between cells, skipping empty ones, with the same tooltip; `Home` / `End`
jump to the first and last cell of the row and `Esc` hides the tooltip. The table view lists every cell.

**Category**: Charts · **Common uses**: Activity by weekday and hour, change compared with a target by team and month (diverging)

## Import

```ts
import { Heatmap } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

A sequential scale for magnitude: lighter is less, darker is more (in dark mode, brighter is more). The color
scale under the cells gives the smallest and largest values.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  return (
    <Heatmap
      title="Sign-ins by weekday and hour"
      xCategories={hours}
      yCategories={days}
      data={activity}
      xLabel="Hour"
      yLabel="Weekday"
      valueLabel="Sign-ins"
      height={280}
    />
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Diverging

`scale="diverging"` colors values above and below `midpoint` (0 by default) with two opposite hues, and the
midpoint itself in gray.

```tsx
export function Diverging() {
  return (
    <Heatmap
      title="Change against the plan"
      description="Points per month"
      xCategories={months}
      yCategories={teams}
      data={changes}
      scale="diverging"
      xLabel="Month"
      yLabel="Team"
      valueLabel="Change"
      format={(v) => (v > 0 ? `+${v}` : String(v))}
      height={200}
    />
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `xCategories` | `readonly string[]` | The columns, left to right. | — | Yes |
| `yCategories` | `readonly string[]` | The rows, top to bottom. | — | Yes |
| `data` | `readonly HeatmapCell[]` | The cells; a cell whose `x` or `y` is not a category, or whose value is missing, is not drawn. | — | Yes |
| `scale` | `'sequential' \| 'diverging'` | `sequential`: one hue from the smallest to the largest value (magnitude); `diverging`: two opposite hues on both sides of `midpoint`, gray at the midpoint (above or below a baseline). | `'sequential'` | No |
| `midpoint` | `number` | The value of the neutral middle of a diverging scale; the scale is symmetric around it. | `0` | No |
| `format` | `ValueFormat` | How values are written in the color scale, the tooltip and the table. | `'auto'` | No |
| `xLabel` | `string` | Name of the columns: the header of the first column of the table view. | — | No |
| `yLabel` | `string` | Name of the rows: the header of the second column of the table view. | — | No |
| `valueLabel` | `string` | Name of the values, in the tooltip and as the header of the value column. "Value" by default in the table (follows `locale`). | — | No |
| `title` | `string` | Title of the chart: what is plotted. It is also the accessible name of the graphic. | — | No |
| `description` | `string` | A short description under the title, such as the period or the unit. | — | No |
| `height` | `number` | Height of the graphic in pixels, axis labels included. The states take the same height. The table view starts at this height and grows with its rows up to 480 px (or this height when it is taller); only longer tables scroll. | `240` | No |
| `loading` | `boolean` | Loading: without data, a delayed loading indicator takes the place of the graphic; with data, the previous graphic stays at reduced opacity until the new data arrives. | — | No |
| `error` | `ReactNode` | Error: `true` shows the default error state; a node is shown as the message of the error state. | — | No |
| `onRetry` | `() => void` | Retry after an error; shows a "Retry" button in the error state. | — | No |
| `emptyDescription` | `ReactNode` | Text of the empty state when there is no data, "No data" by default (follows `locale`). | — | No |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` | Actions in the top-right corner, before the view switch (for example a menu or a time range). | — | No |
| `plain` | `boolean` | Without the card (no background, shadow or padding), for charts inside a Panel, a dialog or a drawer. | — | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
